title: Smart Data Models - Agrifood / AgriSoilSample
description: A physical soil sample taken from one depth interval, either a single core at a point or a composite of several cores over a zone, together with its laboratory results. One entity per depth interval.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity Type. It has to be AgriSoilSample

location.description: GeoProperty. Where the sample was taken: a Point for a single core, a Polygon for a composite of several cores

hasAgriParcel.description: Relationship. Parcel where the sample was taken

hasAgriManagementZone.description: Relationship. Management zone the sample represents, for composite samples per zone

hasAgriSoil.description: Relationship. Soil type the sample belongs to, if known

dateSampled.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time when the sample was taken in the field

dateAnalysed.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time when the laboratory analysed the sample

depthFrom.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'m'. Upper limit of the sampled layer, measured from the soil surface

depthTo.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'m'. Lower limit of the sampled layer, measured from the soil surface

numberOfSubsamples.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Number of cores mixed into the sample, 1 for a single core

sampleCode.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Code that identifies the sample at the laboratory

laboratory.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Name of the laboratory that analysed the sample

analysisMethod.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Default analytical method or standard applied to the sample as a whole

sand.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Sand content of the fine earth, as a fraction between 0 and 1

silt.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Silt content of the fine earth, as a fraction between 0 and 1

clay.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Clay content of the fine earth, as a fraction between 0 and 1

organicCarbon.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Organic carbon content by mass, as a fraction between 0 and 1

organicMatter.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Organic matter content by mass, as a fraction between 0 and 1

totalNitrogen.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Total nitrogen content by mass, as a fraction between 0 and 1

carbonates.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Total carbonates content by mass, as calcium carbonate equivalent, as a fraction between 0 and 1

activeLime.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Active lime content by mass, as calcium carbonate equivalent, as a fraction between 0 and 1

coarseFragments.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Volume of coarse fragments larger than 2 mm, as a fraction between 0 and 1

soilPh.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Soil pH measured in water unless analysisMethod states otherwise. Same term as in AgriParcelRecord

electricalConductivity.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'dS/m'. Electrical conductivity of the soil extract

cec.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'cmol(+)/kg'. Cation exchange capacity of the soil

bulkDensity.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'kg/m3'. Dry bulk density of the soil

nitrateN.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Nitrate nitrogen content of the dry soil

ammoniumN.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Ammonium nitrogen content of the dry soil

phosphorusAvailable.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Available phosphorus as P, extracted with the method in phosphorusMethod

phosphorusMethod.description: Property. Enum:'olsen, bray1, mehlich3, ammoniumLactate, ammoniumAcetateEdta, calciumLactate, calciumLactateAcetate, water, cacl2'. Extraction method of phosphorusAvailable, required when that value is present

potassiumExchangeable.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Exchangeable potassium as K, extracted with the method in potassiumMethod

potassiumMethod.description: Property. Enum:'ammoniumAcetate, mehlich3, ammoniumLactate, calciumAmmoniumLactate'. Extraction method of potassiumExchangeable, required when that value is present

penetrationResistance.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'Pa'. Penetration resistance of the soil layer

parameter.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Name of the measured parameter

value.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Measured value of the parameter

unitCode.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/unitCode'. Unit of the value as a UN/CEFACT common code

method.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Analytical method used for this parameter

otherResults.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/ItemList'. Results of parameters that have no dedicated property, each with its unit and method
